Simulate a synthetic city

Source: R/simulate.R
bruce_simulate.Rd

Generates data from the BRUCE data-generating process on an invented city, for testing the pipeline and checking parameter recovery: two covariates (elev, a pair of hills; urb, an urban core), a reference network, a biased low-cost network, an optional coarse background product, a Matern field with AR(1) dependence between days and a city-wide daily AR(1) term.

Usage

bruce_simulate(
  n_reference = 12,
  n_biased = 40,
  n_days = 10,
  extent = 30000,
  range = 8000,
  sigma = 1,
  group_rho = 0.6,
  intercept = 25,
  beta_elev = -0.0065,
  beta_urb = 1.5,
  day_sd = 1.5,
  day_rho = 0.7,
  bias = 1.5,
  sd_reference = 0.3,
  sd_biased = 1,
  sd_station = 0.5,
  background = TRUE,
  background_res = 9000,
  background_sd = 0.7,
  res = 250,
  crs = 31983,
  origin = c(650000, 7450000),
  clustered = FALSE,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_reference, n_biased

Number of reference and low-cost stations.

n_days

Number of days.

extent

Side of the square domain (metres).

range, sigma

Matern range (metres) and standard deviation of the field (smoothness 1).

group_rho

Day-to-day correlation of the field.

intercept, beta_elev, beta_urb

Mean level and covariate effects (beta_elev per metre of elevation, beta_urb per unit urban fraction).

day_sd, day_rho

Standard deviation and autocorrelation of the daily term.

bias

Offset of the low-cost network.

sd_reference, sd_biased

Observation noise of each network.

sd_station

Standard deviation of persistent per-station offsets in the low-cost network.

background

Simulate a coarse background product.

background_res, background_sd

Its cell size (metres) and noise.

res

Covariate raster resolution (metres).

crs

EPSG code used for the coordinates.

origin

Lower-left corner of the domain in crs.

clustered

If TRUE, low-cost stations concentrate in the urban core, mimicking the deployment pattern that drove field collapse in the original application.

seed

Random seed.

Value

A list with obs, stations, sources, background, covariates (SpatRaster), domain (sf polygon), crs, truth (SpatRaster, one layer per day, latent temperature) and params. The first four plug straight into bruce_data().
